selection.description: Quota 1 ranks the converted school average. Quota 2 assesses entry-subject grades, eligible post-school activities and the programme-specific essay. Meeting entry requirements does not secure a place.
Quota 2 essay counts only if school was completed at least three months before 15 March. Same-year May IB candidates cannot gain credit for the essay.
245 study places in 2026, split 60 per cent quota 1 and 40 per cent quota 2. 3,069 applications in 2026, up 23 per cent on 2025.

requirements.label: Full IB Diploma, or Course Results with a qualifying further-education route confirmed by CBS

alternatives.label: Course Results with supplementary study: individual CBS qualification confirmation

requirements.note: Course Results alone do not qualify. CBS lists HF/GSK or 60 ECTS supplementation; the national evidence differs, so this tool cannot confirm either supplementary pathway. Do not treat an existing supplementary qualification as a rejection.

openFor.question: Do you need a student residence permit for Denmark? If so, CBS requires final entry documents by 15 March noon. Same-year IB results access in July does not establish an exception; obtain CBS confirmation of your timing and residence status.

requirements.label: Language requirement: English A, or English B at 6.0 plus an English test

officialWording.text: You can only take a language test to fulfil the language requirement English level A if you have already passed English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. … The IELTS Academic test must be passed with both an overall score of at least 7.0 and a minimum score of 6.0 for each of the four different sections. … The TOEFL iBT/ iBT Home Edition taken on or after 21 January 2026 must be passed with both a minimum overall score of at least 5 and a minimum score of 4,5 in each of the four different sections.

alternatives.label: An English test on top of English B at 5 or better in IB (Danish 6.0)
alternatives.note: IELTS Academic 7.0 overall and at least 6.0 in each section, or TOEFL iBT 5 overall and at least 4.5 in each (taken on or after 21 January 2026); Cambridge C1 Advanced 185 or C2 Proficiency 200 also count. CBS must have the result by 5 July, 12:00.

requirements.note: CBS application-and-admission page, read in a browser 25 Sep 2026. Cambridge C1 Advanced (185) or C2 Proficiency (200) meets both English B at 6.0 and the English A requirement. Test results must reach CBS by 5 July, 12:00; a test date may be at most two years old on 5 July.

alternativeTest.note: CBS: passing one of these Cambridge exams with the required score fulfils both English B at 6.0 and the English A language requirement. CBS must have the result by 5 July, 12:00

officialRequirementsText.text: Specific entry requirements: English level B with a minimum grade of 6.0. Mathematics level B. History level B or International Economics level B or Social Studies level B or History of Ideas level B or Contemporary History level B. Language requirement: English level A. You must fulfil both the specific entry requirements and the language requirement to be eligible for the programme.

notes: The cut-off has been 11.1 or higher every year since 2023 (11.5 in 2023, 11.4 in 2024, 11.1 in 2025 and 2026).
Two tri-continental exchange options, TREBLE and Global SCLM, are open to enrolled students by competitive application in the first semester; they are not part of the admission process.

Non-EU tuition at institution level: EUR 6,500 per semester (EUR 13,000 per year), or DKK 49,000 per semester (DKK 98,000 per year), for bachelor programmes. Application fee EUR 150 (approximately DKK 1,125) per applicant per admission round, payable by 15 March at 12.00 CET. EU/EEA and Swiss citizens pay neither.
Current rules checked 4 November 2026. Historic places/cut-offs remain labelled 2026; no 2027 admission guarantee.
Same-year applicants needing a student residence permit for Denmark face a 15 March qualification-document deadline; whether CBS offers any IB-results exception is unresolved.

CBS explicitly limits its standard upper-secondary assessments to the 2026 admission round and promises updated assessments before applications reopen. The 2027 IB assessment is unconfirmed; the review requirement prevents a current-year eligibility assurance.
